_comment: Per-(resource,group) 0x14 name-island override. Applied to the ACTIVE speaker slice in patch_section1_offsets BEFORE name_labels lookup. Reason: 士騎戦 decodes to 'Knight' globally but is really 冒険者/Adventurer in these groups (Glyph-Page Law); a global name_labels flip would corrupt R1196 g752 Lady Knight and R1206 g244 Uuri.
